greeting: A wide-open day on the Croatian coast, Dan. The only fixed point is the NACD committee call at 1, and ten quiet minutes of wifi on the return logistics is the thing most worth doing before the boat cuts you off.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: You are off the boat Saturday noon at Komolac, but the airport transfer, the hotel bag-hold, and a 5:15 AM Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight all still need arranging from dry land while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Book the TPA rental car outright
needsAttention.detail: Full-size SUV, Tampa, Sept 20 to Oct 5 -- this p1 is now certain, not a hedge, since the Pathfinder is being driven south. Don't land jet-lagged on a Sunday to walk-up rates.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: Two nights, Sept 20 and 21, are still unbooked between the Tampa landing and the Tuesday Orlando villa -- somewhere in the St Pete area for the first two nights back.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book it refundable now -- the Pathfinder is south until late May, so there's no six-seater in Maine otherwise.

schedule.title: NACD New England programming committee
schedule.detail: Zoom -- early evening where you are

flagged.title: Senior Director, US Public Affairs
flagged.detail: LinkedIn alert for an EPM Scientific role, 300-320K -- worth a look when you're back at a desk.

flagged.title: Two LinkedIn connection requests
flagged.detail: A Deloitte global public-policy lead and an executive-search partner are both waiting on a response.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail sales, an ICGN Toronto invite, and a FICO balance alert -- nothing time-sensitive.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples want a free-form crust and little else.

tasks.title: Check for a better St Pete Airbnb before the Sept 18 charge

acts.line: Open water and nothing on the calendar until the afternoon.
The NACD New England programming committee meets by Zoom, early evening on the Adriatic.
The books are clear; the Cavtat handoff is the week's last errand ashore.
